# Leaving Batcher for Daft

This page maps Batcher spellings back to Daft, for code moving the other way. It lists only the rows whose status is canonical or alias, where both engines compute the same thing. A Batcher spelling that behaves differently in Daft isn't listed here, so look it up on the forward pages in {doc}`index` before porting it.

To rewrite Batcher code the other way, run the codemod in reverse:

```bash
python -m batcher.migrate --from batcher --to daft <paths>
```

Replace `<paths>` with the files or directories to rewrite. This direction is implemented. Without `--write` the command prints a diff and changes nothing, and `--write` applies it.

## Batcher to Daft

The following table maps 206 Batcher spellings to the Daft names that compute the same thing, sorted by Batcher spelling. Each Daft name is prefixed with the class or module it lives on.
